designations.eng: Minimum load of the measuring range (Dmin)
designations.fra: Charge minimale de l'étendue de mesure

eng: Minimum load of the measuring range (Dmin)

terms.designation: Minimum load of the measuring range (Dmin)

definitions.content: Smallest value of a quantity (mass) which is applied to a load cell during test or use. This value shall not be less than Emin.

terms.designation: Charge minimale de l'étendue de mesure

definitions.content: Plus petite valeur d'une grandeur (masse) appliquée à une cellule de pesée en cours d'essai ou d'utilisation.
